channel.title: FOX Television Stations - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from FOX Television Stations (foxla.com)

item.title: Deadly LaGuardia runway crash raises concerns over aviation safety, controller shortage
item.description: A deadly runway collision at LaGuardia Airport is raising renewed concerns about aviation safety and the nationwide shortage of air traffic controllers.

item.title: LA homeless crisis: City vows to address people living in underground storm drains
item.description: A disturbing discovery in South Los Angeles revealed people living inside storm drains amid unsafe and unsanitary conditions.

item.title: Jury deadlocked in landmark Meta, Youtube social media addiction trial
item.description: A Los Angeles judge warns of a partial retrial as jurors struggle to reach a verdict in the landmark addiction lawsuit against Meta and YouTube.

item.title: Over 100 LA shelter dogs flown to Chicago for adoption to escape euthanasia
item.description: Nearly 100 Los Angeles shelter dogs were flown to Chicago for adoption to create space for over 300 animals seized in a Lake Hughes animal cruelty and hoarding investigation.

item.title: LA leaders to vote on stripping César Chávez’s name amid abuse allegations
item.description: Los Angeles officials are considering motions to rename holidays and schools honoring César Chávez following sexual abuse allegations from Dolores Huerta and others.

item.title: Thai artist Jeff Satur expands his universe beyond ‘Red Giant’
item.description: Thai superstar Jeff Satur is continuing to expand his global presence — and during a recent stop in Los Angeles, he shared more about the stories behind his music and upcoming projects.

item.title: Southern California residents: LA28 launches Olympic ticket sales with seats starting at $28
item.description: LA28 Olympic tickets launched April 2 with a local pre-sale for Southern California residents, followed by a global public sale on April 9.

item.title: DOJ targets California’s ‘kingdom of fraud’ in massive $60M hospice takedown
item.description: Federal prosecutors have charged over a dozen people in Los Angeles allegedly linked to a $60 million Medicare fraud scheme involving sham hospices and illegal kickbacks under "Operation Never Say Die."

item.title: B.I speaks on keeping the world 'BUZZIN' with new track
item.description: Global artist B.I talked with FOX 11 about his new single “BUZZIN" — a smooth, confident track designed to give listeners a boost whenever they need it.

item.title: Compton man sentenced in violent dating app kidnapping plot in Orange
item.description: Gustavo Deluna of Compton received a 270-month federal prison sentence for a 2024 kidnapping for ransom in the city of Orange.

item.title: 4-year-old bitten twice by 'repeat offender' coyote in Carson attack
item.description: DNA testing confirmed the animal is the same coyote involved in a previous attack that occurred in the area last year.

item.title: Massive eye drop recall: FDA warns of sterility issues in 3 million bottles
item.description: The FDA has announced a recall of over 3 million bottles of eye drops sold at Walgreens, CVS, Kroger, and more due to potential sterility issues.

item.title: Woman arrested in connection with fire at Target in Burbank
item.description: A woman was arrested in connection to a fire at the Empire Center location of Target in Burbank.

item.title: Burbank police honor fallen K-9 Spike with Baker to Vegas victory
item.description: The Burbank Police Department honored fallen K-9 Spike during the department's Baker to Vegas victory.

item.title: Man found dead in tent near LA River days after FOX 11 report on drug, safety concerns
item.description: A homeless man was found dead in a tent along the Los Angeles River near Griffith Park, with advocates saying the death is believed to be a possible drug overdose.
